about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn about Mujaddidun Association and our vision for a better tomorrow.
about.heading: Mujaddidun Charity Development Association - Jordan
about.descriptionP1: Mujaddidun Charity Development Association is a Jordanian association registered with the Ministry of Social Development under No. (1924) since 2009.
about.descriptionP2: The association works to empower youth and serve the community by implementing developmental and humanitarian initiatives and projects, spreading the culture of volunteerism, promoting the values of social responsibility, and contributing to sustainable development.
about.descriptionP3: The association strives to build a more cohesive society through partnership with institutions and individuals, and by delivering quality programs that serve all segments of the community.
about.missionText: Empowering individuals and communities through sustainable developmental and humanitarian programs, and promoting a culture of volunteering and initiative in service of Jordanian society.
about.visionText: A cohesive, aware, and proactive Jordanian society whose members participate in sustainable development and in creating positive impact.
about.storyText: Mujaddidun Charity Development Association is a Jordanian association registered with the Ministry of Social Development under No. (1924) since 2009, working to empower youth and serve the community through sustainable developmental and humanitarian initiatives.
about.valuesText1: Transparency: Clarity in all our dealings and projects.
about.valuesText2: Responsibility: Our commitment to the community and the trust of our partners.
about.valuesText3: Sustainability: Focusing on projects with long-term impact.
